method.name: generate_mesh
method.description: Generates the vertex based mesh from the voxel data.

method.name: get_voxel
method.description: Gets a voxel a a given position. An empty dictionary means air, otherwise the format is as follows {"color": [Color], "material": [VMaterial], "transparent": [bool]}

method.name: has_voxel
method.description: Returns true, if at p_Pos a voxel exists.

method.name: remove_voxel
method.description: Removes a voxel on a given position.

method.name: set_voxel
method.description: Sets a voxel at a given position. If p_MaterialIdx is invalid, the material will be fallback to the default one.

members.member: If frustum culling enabled is set to true, only chunks inside the frustum of the camera are meshed.
Sets the mesher type. Each mesher type produces a more or less optimized vertex mesh.
Sets the model type, which determines how the mesh of this model should be updated, when voxels are changed.

constants.constant: Generates for each visible voxel at least one face (Lots of faces)
Similar voxels are grouped into one big face (Less faces)
Similar to greedy but only works on one chunk at the time. (Less faces but more than just greedy)
Voxels with similar material are grouped into one big face. Each voxel color is rendered onto a texture. (Less faces, if you have a lot of texture)
Generates a smooth surface using the Transvoxel algorithm (Lots of faces, but smoother)
The complete voxel model is generated everytime, if something changed.
Only chunks which had been changed are remeshed.
